section_summary.extract_value: This conclusion section summarizes the findings of a single study, indicating that the final model, which investigated interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating, fit well with college women. Body appreciation was found to play a central mediational role in these links but did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms. The authors suggest exploring this model with diverse samples in future research.
